meta.name: Cordon evaluation dataset
meta.construction: intent templates x parameter grids (deterministic, no randomness)

policies.title: No unrestricted SSH ingress
policies.rule: A firewall rule MUST NOT allow port 22 (SSH) from 0.0.0.0/0.
policies.source: CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark v3.0, control 5.2

policies.title: No unrestricted RDP ingress
policies.rule: A firewall rule MUST NOT allow port 3389 (RDP) from 0.0.0.0/0.
policies.source: CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark v3.0, control 5.2

policies.title: No fully-open port range
policies.rule: A firewall rule MUST NOT allow all ports (0-65535) from 0.0.0.0/0.
policies.source: CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark v3.0, control 5.2 (generalised)

policies.title: No public storage buckets
policies.rule: A storage bucket MUST NOT be created or set with public access.
policies.source: CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark v3.0, control 2.1.5

policies.title: Encryption required at rest
policies.rule: A storage bucket MUST have server-side encryption enabled.
policies.source: CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark v3.0, control 2.1.1

policies.title: Production instance size ceiling
policies.rule: A compute instance in the production environment MUST NOT exceed size 'large'.

policies.title: Production deletion requires approval
policies.rule: Deleting any resource in the production environment REQUIRES human approval.
